Package com.nexuslink.protocol.mongo

Class CollectionDiff

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.protocol.mongo.CollectionDiff
public final class CollectionDiff extends Object
Compares two collections document by document, matched on _id — Studio 3T's Data Compare, which is the feature people buy that licence for.

The classification mirrors the file commander's CollectionDiff.Status idea of a directory diff: present on the left only, on the right only, on both but differing, or identical. For a differing pair the fields that differ are listed, because "these two documents are not equal" is not actionable and "price and updatedAt differ" is.

The result also generates the script that would make the right side match the left, which is the point of comparing in the first place — and it is generated, never applied, so it can be read before anything is written.

Pure: it compares documents already fetched, so the sampling policy and the connection stay with the caller.

  • Method Details

    • compare

      public static List<CollectionDiff.Entry> compare(List<org.bson.Document> left, List<org.bson.Document> right)
      Compares two document lists by _id.

      Documents without an _id cannot be matched and are reported as one-sided entries under a synthetic id, rather than being dropped silently.

    • syncScript

      public static String syncScript(String targetCollection, List<CollectionDiff.Entry> entries)
      The shell script that would make the right collection match the left: inserts for what is missing, replacements for what differs, and deletes for what is extra. Deletes are emitted as comments — removing data is the one direction that should never run because a script was pasted without reading it.
